t: What Space-Based Solar Power Systems Is
title: What Space-Based Solar Power Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Space-based solar power collects sunlight in orbit — where it shines 24/7 with no clouds or night — and beams it to Earth as microwaves or lasers. It is baseload solar power, independent of weather, for anywhere on the planet. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Space-Based Solar Power Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Space-Based Solar Power Systems in one line: Space-based solar power collects sunlight in orbit — where it shines 24/7 with no clouds or night — and beams it to Earth as microwaves or lasers.
Why it matters: Orbital sunlight is 24/7 and 30%+ stronger; beaming it down solves solar's intermittency completely..
Where it is used: baseload clean power, disaster relief, remote bases, grid support..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Space-Based Solar Power Systems
title: Current Research State of Space-Based Solar Power Systems
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Caltech's SSPP demonstrated orbital power beaming; JAXA and China plan demonstrations; launch costs fell 10x. Research focuses on beaming efficiency, large deployable structures, and rectenna economics. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Space-Based Solar Power Systems currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
